open_points.subject: public_op:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings
open_points.text: A missing required setting or a value of the wrong form ends the start.
open_points.question: Must a port whose value has integer form but lies outside 1 to 65535 end the start?
options: End the start for every port outside 1 to 65535, as A8 requires.
Accept any value having integer form, including 0 or 65536, as this Errors passage permits.
open_points.default_guess: End the start unless the parsed port is from 1 to 65535.

witness.initial: PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT is present with value `65536`; all required settings are otherwise valid.
events: module:runtime_settings calls load_runtime_settings and reads the environment.
outcomes: A8 rejects the port because it is outside 1 to 65535, so the start ends.
State 5 treats the value as having the declared integer form, returns run settings, and the start continues toward listening on port 65536.
witness.observer: The deployment operator sees whether the service starts.

open_points.subject: public_op:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings
open_points.text: A missing required setting or a value of the wrong form ends the start.
open_points.question: Must a syntactically valid string naming a time zone unknown to the time-zone database end the start?
options: End the start when the database does not know the time zone, as A8 requires.
Accept every string because `timezone` has the declared `str` form, as this Errors passage permits.
open_points.default_guess: End the start when the time-zone database does not know the value.

witness.initial: PORTAL_DELIVERER_TIMEZONE is `Mars/Olympus_Mons`; all required settings are otherwise valid.
events: module:runtime_settings calls load_runtime_settings and reads the environment.
outcomes: A8 rejects the unknown time zone, so the start ends.
State 5 accepts it as a string of the declared form and returns run settings.
witness.observer: The deployment operator sees whether the service starts.

open_points.subject: public_op:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings
open_points.text: every value has the form its row of the start-up table declares
open_points.question: What exact environment-string grammar is accepted for the integer `port` before its range is checked?
options: Accept only ASCII decimal digits with no sign or surrounding whitespace.
Accept conventional integer spellings such as a leading plus sign or leading zeros.
Use the implementation language's integer parser, including every spelling it accepts.
open_points.default_guess: Accept only one or more ASCII decimal digits, then require a value from 1 to 65535.

witness.initial: PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT is present as `+8850`; all required settings are otherwise valid.
events: module:runtime_settings calls load_runtime_settings and reads the environment.
outcomes: One implementation accepts `+8850` as the whole number 8850 and returns the settings.
Another implementation rejects `+8850` because the declared row does not specify that signed lexical form, ending the start.
witness.observer: The deployment operator sees whether the service starts.
